villagercensus.gui.hint.record_all_trade: Record All Trades is enabled. The selected categories take effect only after you turn it off.
villagercensus.config.generic.comment.tr: Held item used to right-click villagers (registry id). Default: minecraft:enchanted_book
villagercensus.config.generic.comment.re: Record every trade. When off, only the selected categories are recorded.
villagercensus.config.generic.comment.se: Category keys (profession/id) to record when 'Record All Trades' is off. Use the config screen's 'Select Trade Categories...' button.
villagercensus.config.generic.comment.gl: Mark already-recorded villagers with the Glowing effect.
villagercensus.config.generic.comment.re: Record the villager's own block position (never a workstation).
villagercensus.config.generic.comment.ou: Additionally write a machine-readable JSON report next to the TXT report.
villagercensus.config.generic.comment.hu: Show the census HUD while a session is active.
villagercensus.config.generic.comment.of: How long to wait for the merchant offers packet before falling back to client data.
villagercensus.config.generic.comment.au: Save an unfinished session to disk when leaving the world.
villagercensus.config.generic.comment.de: Print extra debug information to the game log.
villagercensus.config.hotkeys.comment.op: Open the Villager Census configuration screen.
villagercensus.config.hotkeys.comment.to: Pause or resume right-click statistics for the current session.
villagercensus.config.hotkeys.comment.un: Undo the most recent successful record or update.
villagercensus.message.name_required: You must give the census a name.
villagercensus.message.already_running: A census is already running. Use /census stop or /census abort first.
villagercensus.message.draft_exists: A draft named %s already exists. Use /census resume to continue it.
villagercensus.message.started: Census "%s" started in %s. Hold the trigger item and right-click villagers.
villagercensus.message.no_target: No villager to attach a remark to yet.

villagercensus.message.dimension_mismatc: The draft belongs to a different dimension.
villagercensus.message.failed: Failed to associate the offers packet with the villager.
villagercensus.message.level_mismatch: Offers packet level mismatch; entry skipped.
villagercensus.message.wait_previous: Waiting for the previous villager; please slow down.
villagercensus.message.unchanged: No changes detected for this villager.
villagercensus.message.pending_update: Changes detected. Right-click the same villager again to overwrite.
villagercensus.message.draft_found: Census draft found: %s | villagers loaded: %s/%s (/census resume to continue, /census discard to archive).
villagercensus.message.fork_name_require: You must give the name of an existing draft or report to fork.
villagercensus.message.fork_not_found: No draft or JSON report named "%s" was found for this world and dimension.
villagercensus.message.fork_unreadable: The fork source "%s" could not be read.
villagercensus.message.fork_started: Forked "%s" started: %s villagers carried over in %s.
villagercensus.message.no_world: You must be in a world to do that.
villagercensus.message.glowing_disabled: Glowing markers are disabled in the config.
villagercensus.message.reverse_on: Marker mode reversed: uncounted villagers glow.
villagercensus.message.reverse_off: Marker mode restored: counted villagers glow.

villagercensus.command.help.stop: /census stop - finish and write the report

villagercensus.hud.pending_update: pending update: right-click again to confirm

villagercensus.report.baby_note: Baby villagers do not show an adult profession.
